`t8-flange-nut.step.gz` is pzfreo/dw-examples' `steps/freecad/t8-flange-nut.step`, gzip-compressed
without changing its STEP bytes: the FreeCAD library's
[Mechanical Parts/Mountings/T8_screw_nut/Flange_nut/T8_Flange_nut.step](https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD-library/blob/f5ca01cdcaa2f69b9295a6382719c2d90628780c/Mechanical%20Parts/Mountings/T8_screw_nut/Flange_nut/T8_Flange_nut.step),
added by hasecilu (`792be62dda`, 2022-03-22). Its bore is a modelled 4-start, 8 mm lead
trapezoidal thread whose flanks a 1 × 45° chamfer splits at the top, which quiddity-rust 0.2.1
refuses (`inconsistent_diameters`) and draftwright measures from the refused faces. Uncompressed
SHA-256: `e62fa7316f034ff98adf3ba701b6bbbabf05786d037af2279e46abb422c8d427`.
